faqs.question: Do you match copy to our ads?
faqs.answer: Yes — we align the landing page message to your ad so visitors get a seamless, high-converting experience.

faqs.question: Can you write A/B variants?
faqs.answer: We can write multiple headline and CTA variants so you can test what converts best.

faqs.question: Do you deliver in Arabic and English?
faqs.answer: Yes — bilingual Arabic + English with full RTL support, so both audiences get a first-class experience.

faqs.question: Do we own the result?
faqs.answer: Completely. You keep the accounts, data, configurations, and documentation. There is no lock-in to CloudTopia.
